components.name: Floor Navigation
components.description: Beveled floor keys in a recessed tray.
components.css: .ds-floors{display:inline-flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;background:#ddd9ce;border:1px solid #c5bdaa;border-radius:9px;box-shadow:var(--pressed,inset 0 2px 4px #342e2515,0 1px 0 #fffaf1)}.ds-floors button{min-width:40px;height:38px;border:1px solid #cec6b5;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(#fffdf5,#eae3d3);color:#76623e;font:17px 'Inria Serif',Georgia,serif;box-shadow:0 2px 2px #67543718,inset 0 1px 0 #fffef5;cursor:pointer}.ds-floors button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--green-surface,linear-gradient(180deg,#365e48,#244c39));color:#fff9e5;border-color:#325b3f;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 4px #12322155,0 1px 0 #fff9e7}.ds-floors button:hover:not([aria-pressed=true]){background:#e7ebe2}.ds-floors button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #316851;outline-offset:4px}.ds-floors button:active{transform:translateY(1px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-floors button:active{transform:none}}

narrative.overview: A formal but welcoming hotel wayfinding interface, with ivory paper, evergreen actions, serif headings and restrained brass details. The selected route-controls-left and large-map-right layout remains authoritative. The user's subsequent skeuomorphic preference supersedes the original flat material treatment. Inset fields, beveled buttons and framed paper surfaces suggest a physical reception desk while preserving actual routing and readable facility names.
keyCharacteristics: Serif hierarchy with compact operational text
Large architectural map with computed meter distances

rules.name: Preserve route semantics
rules.body: Material styling must preserve floor-specific doorways, guest rooms as terminal destinations and the shared geometry used for rendering and validation.

rules.name: Structural depth
rules.body: Recessed inputs and trays contrast with raised actions and paper framing; use the extracted shadows rather than unrelated floating cards.

dos: Do retain the Concierge Desk hierarchy, palette and large map.
Do pair icons with names and preserve keyboard interaction.
Do distinguish implemented tokens from verified browser evidence.
donts: Don't revert to the superseded flat material treatment.
Don't imply that historical artwork or untested accessibility checks passed.
